extDesc.message: Saves the pages you really read to the memory platform you choose.

connHintPick.message: No key? Pick a platform above first.

connNoMatchPick.message: This key isn’t recognised. Pick a platform above.

connSentGlance.message: Pages you view are saved to $1 so you can find them later: address, title, when and how long you viewed them, plus the text (including chat conversations) once you have read for $2 s or a video has played for 1 min.

connSentRead.message: Pages you read for $2 s (or where a video plays for 1 min) are saved to $1 so you can find them later: address, title, text (including chat conversations), and when and how long you viewed them.

connSentNone.message: Pages you view are saved to the platform you connect so you can find them later: address, title, when and how long you viewed them, plus the text (including chat conversations) once you have read for $1 s or a video has played for 1 min.

connSentGlancePlay.message: Pages you view are saved to $1 so you can find them later: address, title, when and how long you viewed them, plus the text (including chat conversations) once you have read for $2 s or a video has played for 1 min; for videos also playback, subtitles and the video file address.

connSentReadPlay.message: Pages you read for $2 s (or where a video plays for 1 min) are saved to $1 so you can find them later: address, title, text (including chat conversations), and when and how long you viewed them; for videos also playback, subtitles and the video file address.

connFailHost.message: Can’t reach $1. Check that the server is running.

connFailPerm.message: No permission. Click “$1” again and choose “Allow”.

onbTagline.message: Keeps the pages you really read

onbPinTail.message: to pin it to the toolbar.

setChangeNs.message: The address is part of the key and changes with it.

setRemoveAsk.message: Remove $1? Its key will be deleted from this browser.

setRemoveAskN.message: Remove $1? Its key and $2 pages waiting to be sent will be deleted from this browser.

setSkipInfo.message: About sites that are not recorded

setSkipTip0.message: You can also add a site from a page’s right-click menu or from the popup.

setSkipTip1.message: Built in: $1 password-manager sites (such as 1password.com) and pages that label themselves adult.

setSkipTip2.message: The built-in list is not complete. Add what it misses.

setSubsSub.message: Saves subtitles of videos watched for 1 min; transcribes those without.

popSkippedN.message: $1 won’t be recorded from now on. Recent records deleted: $2.

popDelHook.message: Deleted here and hidden in $1, from every computer.

popDelAllHook.message: Deleted here and hidden in $1, from every computer. Settings and connections stay.

popDelAllLocal.message: Deleted here. Settings and connections stay.

fieldUrlBad.message: The URL must start with http:// or https://.

fieldBankBad.message: The bank name cannot be empty.

hsRefuseExtracts.message: This bank runs a model over what it stores. Use a new bank name.
